name: Audio rendering
notes: Audio-only output module. AIFF rather than the matrix's MP3: AE ships no MP3 output-module template and getSettings()'s Format key is read-only, so a script cannot select MP3 (RENDER_FINDINGS.md #11). AIFF exercises the same path the case is about -- Video Output off, Output Audio on. Until 2026-10-01 this comp actually rendered H.264 video to a file named .mp3, so no audio-only render was covered.
